tabs.label: Compose
tabs.headline: Music that carries a world
tabs.body: Alexandre produces music in his free time and wants to be hired as a composer for video games — writing themes, stingers, and atmospheres that make levels feel alive.

tabs.label: Levels
tabs.headline: Spaces players learn by playing
tabs.body: Through Unity projects like Level and The Arena, he designs puzzles and encounters that teach mechanics through space, pacing, and curiosity

tabs.label: Azure
tabs.headline: Technical Lead · Microsoft Azure
tabs.body: At Microsoft in Vancouver, Alexandre leads automation and SoC validation across four projects — ARM firmware in SystemC/C/C++, FPGA and silicon test automation in Python and C++, and Azure DevOps (CLI, ADO, REST, AAD, Artifacts). He leads a team of four with SCRUM and standardizes pipelines across orgs.
